template.title: Proper circulant weighing matrix CW({n}, {s}^2)
template.statement: Find a proper circulant weighing matrix CW({n},{k}): a circulant {n} x {n} matrix W with entries -1, 0, 1 and W W^T = {k} I whose first row's support is not inside a coset of a proper subgroup of Z_{n} (an improper one comes from a smaller order).
template.submission: Text file: the first row, {n} entries -1, 0, 1 separated by spaces (or the characters -, 0, +).

score: 1 for a proper CW of these parameters; none is known, so the best known value is 0
best_text: Its existence is Open in Gordon's repository: no proper matrix is known and none has been ruled out, so the best known value is {best}; a valid first row scores 1.
open_rule: every entry CW(n,s) with status Open (n < 1,000, s < 20; the repository's statuses are about proper matrices)
left_out: 792 entries known to exist (All or Yes) and 12124 known not to exist (No)
